pages.text: Right-click a packed pipe, cigar, or cigarette to smoke one puff. Smoking produces smoke/sound and, when enabled by the server, applies Tobacconist's $(thing)Nicotine$() effect for $(item)500 ticks$() (25 seconds).

Puff counts:$(br2)$(item)Cigarette:$() 15$(br)$(item)Cigar:$() 100$(br)$(item)Packed pipe:$() 40$(br2)Cigars and cigarettes use item damage as the puff counter; packed pipes use their own stored Puffs Left value.
pages.title: Puff Counts

pages.text: With the quality system enabled, sufficiently high-quality tobacco grants short Regeneration:$(br2)Quality 70–89: Regen I for 3s$(br)Quality 90–97: Regen I for 5s$(br)Quality 98+: Regen II for 6s
pages.title: Quality Bonus

pages.text: Aging extends that Regeneration duration by $(item)+1 second per 30 aged days$(), capped at +10 seconds. This bonus only matters when the smoked tobacco already qualifies for a quality Regeneration tier.
pages.title: Aging Bonus

pages.text: Server configuration can disable the Nicotine status effect without disabling smoking itself. Administrators may also define additional status effects; those are independent from the quality bonus and from the Nicotine toggle.
pages.title: Server Rules
